item_cf.score: sum of item similarities to full observed history

bpr.positive_sampling: uniform bootstrap over training interaction pairs
bpr.negatives: one uniform catalog draw per positive, excluding all user training positives
bpr.score: user factor dot item factor + item bias

selection: all-user validation NDCG@10; checkpoint and configuration fixed before test
test_history: CF adds validation interaction to query only; BPR factors remain training-only and validation is added to filtering
shared_protocol: full catalog, observed-item filtering, deterministic item-ID ties, main and no-boundary-tie metrics; retain cold targets
